title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 25 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 25 February 2026 Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and Monaragala districts after 2.00 p.m. Mainly fair weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western and North-western provinces and in Anuradhapura, Galle, Matara, Monaragala, Mannar and Vavuniya districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
